True love is the act that brings peace to the heart. It embodies many meanings of compassion and kindness, which every human being seeks throughout their life. If one finds it, they possess not only life itself, but the entire world. 
 
When we are able to give happiness and joy to others, we must practice true love, for love is kindness and the desire to bring happiness to those we love. 
 
Love is a mighty force, transcending our limitations and time and space; even death cannot weaken it. When we lose a loved one, we sometimes find in poetry a way to keep their memory alive and express our feelings. These sincere words, expressed by some singers in their sweet voices, are a bridge connecting the past to the present, allowing us to express our love, our pain, and our longing for those who have left us. So I say to my beloved:                                                                          “If you wake up one morning and do not find me, then begin your life without me. And if anyone sees you crying, with tears in your eyes, say: These are raindrops falling on my face. So please, do not cry, and do not grieve over my departure.”Just live your life and enjoy its beauty.
